svg.aria-label: Six checks from one month, each green, each with a region of its subject it never examined: isOnLand skipped everything outside the coastline clip, check-slugs skipped stations absent from the lock, the tool benchmark skipped what the tool returned, the CLI selftest skipped the plain-list warning format, the browser smoke test skipped the two seconds after the canvas appeared, and the unit suite skipped anything needing WebGL.
